files.name: COMMIT_MSG.seen.1
files.content:
Update slugify to strip punctuation, collapse separators, and trim

Make slugify strip punctuation characters while preserving hyphens,
collapse consecutive whitespace and hyphens into a single '-', and
trim leading and trailing hyphens.

files.name: COMMIT_MSG.seen.2
files.content:
Add test cases for punctuation, repeated spaces, and empty input

Add comprehensive unit tests in tests/test_slug.py covering punctuation
stripping, repeated spaces and hyphens collapsing, and empty/whitespace
input handling while preserving the original basic test.

files.name: COMMIT_MSG.seen.3
files.content:
Finalize documentation and report for slugify updates

Complete REPORT.md, NOTES.md, and PLAN.md documenting changes to slugify,
new unit tests, assumptions, and verification details.

files.name: COMMIT_MSG.seen.4
files.content:
Finalize slugify implementation, test cases, and documentation

Update slugify in slug/__init__.py to strip punctuation, collapse repeated
separators into '-', and trim leading/trailing hyphens. Add tests in
tests/test_slug.py covering punctuation, repeated spaces, and empty input.
